title: Write, add, flag output (pipeline write step)
description: Structured output of the write call. Flat on purpose: no $ref and no recursion. Ids are plain strings. The backend validates them against the catalogue: 'items' must hold exactly the matched ids, 'proposed_additions' ids must come from the unmatched list, and any other id is dropped and logged (decision 23). The backend copies severity, probability and points from the catalogue; the model never returns them (decision 6).
$comment: This file is the base schema. The backend builds the schema it sends to Ollama per call: it sets 'enum' on items.items.properties.id to the matched ids, 'enum' on proposed_additions.items.properties.id to the unmatched ids, and 'minItems' and 'maxItems' on 'items' to the matched count. It adds no other field. Severity, points and quirks never enter this schema.

items.description: Exactly one object per matched entry, in the input order.

id.description: A matched catalogue entry id, copied from the input.

why.description: Two sentences. Why this entry applies to this home, from the triggering facts.

benefit.description: Two sentences. What the mitigation gives the customer. May mention the points available.

doubt.description: True when the match may be wrong. Flags never change the score (decision 14).

doubt_reason.description: One sentence that names the profile field in doubt. Empty string when doubt is false.

proposed_additions.description: Unmatched entries the model thinks apply. Empty when none.

id.description: An id from the unmatched list.

reason.description: One sentence with the profile fact that makes the entry fit.
